name: ns_proofsearch_stationary_euler_escape
rubric_version_reason: Successor after Phase 5DI/5DJ compressed pressure-active residual-zero packets into stationary Euler eigenflow degeneracy. The target is now pressure-profit escape or no-go classification, with an explicit anti-tautology bar requiring observables to be independent of the claimed result.
description: Focused theorem-search substrate for escaping or classifying stationary-Euler single-eigenvalue pressure-active Navier-Stokes packets.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative frontier theorem-search over finite-mode pressure-profit escape, residual-defect transfer, and no-go classification.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by theorem burden, pressure-profit accounting, residual-defect accounting, and no-go strength.
enable_fit_primitive_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate; do not route as numerical fit primitive.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The prior run already found exact pressure-active residual-zero packets and the follow-up compressed them into stationary Euler single-eigenvalue degeneracy. Do not reward another pressure-source-only packet. Reward either a positive escape with controlled projected residual/Defect_n and signed pressure-profit/recurrence, or a no-go theorem classifying a stated finite-mode class as harmless stationary Euler/Beltrami degeneracy. Penalize Clay overclaims, pressure-gauge artifacts, metric-kernel substitution, envelope-only pincer repeats, approximate-equals-exact laundering, and tautological observables whose definitions already contain the desired conclusion.

dimensions.name: Stationary-Euler Escape Ambition
dimensions.description: Does the submission materially escape, classify, or obstruct the stationary-Euler single-eigenvalue degeneracy identified in Phase 5DJ?

dimensions.name: Pressure-Profit Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it distinguish pressure source/visibility from signed pressure-strain, recurrence, resupply, or Leray-visible velocity profit?

dimensions.name: Residual-Defect Accounting
dimensions.description: Does it explicitly track projected NSE residual, reset residual, transfer margin, or Defect_n rather than laundering approximate packets as exact?

dimensions.name: Explicit Object Specificity
dimensions.description: Does it define concrete Fourier packets, function spaces, streamfunctions, Beltrami/planar classes, pressure reconstructions, or observables precisely enough to falsify?

dimensions.name: No-Go Or Construction Strength
dimensions.description: Does it provide either a plausible positive construction or a sharp no-go classification with stated hypotheses and failure boundary?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a theorem packet, proof skeleton, CAS/Lean-facing object list, discriminator, or project-reranking that advances the proof graph?

dimensions.name: Adversarial Falsifier Quality
dimensions.description: Does it name the cheapest falsifier: hidden projected residual, pressure-gauge artifact, stationary-Euler collapse, reset tax, or sign/profit failure?

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology Independence
dimensions.description: HARD GATE. Are escape, profit, recurrence, residual tolerance, and Defect_n defined independently of the candidate's post-hoc success rather than baking in the conclusion? Stand-alone load-bearing claims score zero: pressure-source-only, eigenquestion-malformed-without-reframe, partition-without-profit-verdict, complement-of-stationary-Euler-without-predefined-observable, and formal-language metaphor without a theorem.

dimensions.name: Scope Honesty And Nonclaim Control
dimensions.description: Does it avoid regularity/blowup overclaims and keep flat-torus, finite-mode, exact/approximate, and pressure-gauge scope explicit?

criteria.Stationary_Euler_Escape_Ambition: Full credit requires materially escaping, classifying, or obstructing the stationary-Euler single-eigenvalue degeneracy; pressure-active-only packets receive low credit.
criteria.Pressure_Profit_Discipline: Full credit requires explicit separation of nonzero pressure source from signed pressure-strain, recurrence, resupply, or Leray-visible velocity profit.
criteria.Residual_Defect_Accounting: Full credit requires projected residual/Defect_n/reset tax accounting sufficient to say whether an approximate packet transfers to true NSE behavior.
criteria.Explicit_Object_Specificity: Full credit requires concrete definitions of Fourier modes, streamfunctions, pressure reconstruction, observables, and hypotheses.
criteria.No_Go_Or_Construction_Strength: Full credit requires either a positive construction with obligations or a no-go theorem with a sharp class boundary.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a theorem packet, proof skeleton, CAS/Lean-facing object list, discriminator, or project-reranking.
criteria.Adversarial_Falsifier_Quality: Full credit requires naming what would kill the proposal and how to test it cheaply.
criteria.Anti_Tautology_Independence: Full credit requires observables and thresholds to be specified independently of the claimed result. Score ZERO for pressure-source-only, eigenquestion-malformed-without-reframe, partition-without-profit-verdict, complement-of-stationary-Euler-without-predefined-observable, or formal-language metaphor without a theorem. Reject definitions of escape/profit/recurrence/Defect_n that already contain positive pressure profit, post-hoc margin improvement, or the desired no-go conclusion.
criteria.Scope_Honesty_And_Nonclaim_Control: Reject Clay-level overclaims, pressure-gauge artifacts, metric-kernel substitution, envelope-only repeats, and approximate-equals-exact laundering.

success_criteria: An explicit residual-small pressure-profit escape candidate with pressure source, signed profit, projected residual, and Defect_n obligations.
A no-go theorem classifying a broad finite-mode pressure-active residual-zero class as stationary Euler/Beltrami degeneracy.
A residual/reset/defect tax theorem blocking finite-mode pressure-profit escape from the stationary-Euler manifold.
A decisive proof-cost reranking between formalizing Phase 5DI/5DJ, broadening the finite-mode taxonomy, or abandoning this route.
failure_modes: Finding another pressure-active packet without pressure-profit or residual-defect transfer.
Restating the equal-shell dual-shear theorem without the stationary-Euler compression.
Claiming pressure source implies blowup, recurrence, or useful work.
Defining escape, pressure profit, recurrence, residual tolerance, or Defect_n from the candidate's post-hoc gain/loss margin.
Proving an implication whose antecedent already contains the desired pressure-profit or no-go conclusion.
Ignoring gauge, Leray projection, or projected residual.
Using broad pincer exponents without explicit packet realization.
